newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $103.50/dressed, slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $103.50/dressed, slow - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis and dressed basis sales were near steady, USDA said. Demand and seller interest was uneven.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 103.00-103.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 103.00-103.50.
